recommendation: Keep the source fix. If the QUICK model-definition example is regenerated, ensure medication dosage schedule metadata continues to use timing with datatype Timing per the historical FHIR-5861/FHIR-8180 decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5861 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue from the DSTU1 ballot. It reported inconsistent dosage schedule naming between MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.scheduled[x] and MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction.schedule[x], and the final resolution was to change prescription, dispense, and statement dosage schedule elements to timing with datatype Timing.
initial_application: The Jira comment said FHIR-5861 would be resolved as part of FHIR-8180. Historical #8180 commits a2fbf41966, 33ed8e5b84, and 102f3de87b applied the rename and type simplification to the DSTU-era MedicationPrescription, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement source spreadsheets/examples. Later source refactoring moved MedicationPrescription to MedicationRequest and moved medication dosage timing into the shared Dosage/DosageDetails model.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, MedicationStatement, and Library as active resources, and documents that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current active medication definitions now point dosageInstruction/dosage to DosageDetails, with Dosage.timing represented as Timing. The active QUICK model-definition Library content still exposed the old DSTU medication dosage metadata names, while community searches found no contrary Zulip or Confluence record.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml so QUICK.MedicationDispense.Dosage, QUICK.MedicationStatement.Dosage, and QUICK.MedicationPrescription.Dosage each expose a single timing element of type QUICK.Timing. Left primary medication StructureDefinitions, the current Dosage datatype, FHIR model-definition content, and unrelated QUICK schedule/scheduled elements unchanged.
source_changes: source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml: replaced stale QUICK medication dosage schedule/scheduled metadata with timing: QUICK.Timing for MedicationDispense, MedicationStatement, and MedicationPrescription dosage classes.
